answer: A sybil farm must post a separate bond per fake identity and sustain real compute for each beacon, so costs scale linearly with fake agents while honest rewards stay fixed. Each agent must burn a copper-backed bond to register, and every epoch it broadcasts a signed beacon proving continuous work; peers verify the beacon against the on-chain bond before attesting. The old fable that identities are free collapses once every mask carries collateral plus ongoing proof-of-work. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
